title: Resting and pneumonia after returning from Basie
summary: He rested a long time after the Basie stint, mentions pneumonia, and cannot recall his first job back.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians
